before_selector: stack present bit and its optional raw count/max/arrays
durability present bit and optional pair of float32
armor health present bit and optional pair of float32
fast_array_header: raw int32 ArrayKey, BaseKey, NumDeletes, NumChanges
payload_alignment: Archive raw bytes at current bit cursor; no padding
initial_state_policy: Each local match starts ArrayKey=1, BaseKey=-1; later chunks require previous real ACK and use the previous key as BaseKey
gun_chunk_policy: Each GunInventoryItem is isolated; other items use at most four original GIDs per stage
